responsive.phone: Card and background track are stacked in a fixed-position box; sticker corner decorations scaled down.
responsive.tablet: Card padding increases (tablet:px-10 tablet:py-[60px]); background track box gets a fixed offset (tablet:top-[219px] tablet:h-[313.8px]) instead of the phone's percentage-based centering; heading steps to tablet:text-h4-t.
responsive.desktop: Track box offset changes again to a larger fixed value (desktop:top-[255.7px] desktop:h-[366.3px]); heading steps to desktop:text-h4 with desktop:text-body-l for body copy.
